Bug_Title: AssertJ assertions "allMatch" and "doesNotContains" should also test for emptiness
Bug_Explanation: The bug is that the 'allMatch' method is used on an empty list without checking for its emptiness. This will always return true, even if the list is empty.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case 'testShowBug' triggered the bug by expecting'showBug' method to return false when the 'logs' list is empty. However, 'allMatch' method will return true for an empty list, causing the test to fail.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results do not demonstrate the bug was triggered. Even though the list is empty, the allMatch method returns true because it doesn't have any elements that don't contain 'error'. The test expects false, but the method actually returned true, which is why the test passed.
